subject: minimum sample size for CAR models

messages.author: 5914e579c97f1326
messages.subject: minimum sample size for CAR models
parts:
when using a CAR model to overcome issues around small sample sizes to estimate coverage of the predictors of child survival at small sub-national units is there any literature on the minimum sample size in each small area? say n=10, n=5, n=20. Any leads to rule of thumbs and/or literature ?

I have data with very variable sample size across small areas. some have n=1, meaning the proportion with be either 1/1=100% or 0/1=0%, which is not the reality.
